title: Observability: Sentry behind SENTRY_DSN and structured JSON server logs (respec of T-0287 after spec review T-0290)
spec:
Respec of T-0287 (held at spec review T-0290); same why (roadmap 3.6, P0-5 web/API part). Corrections folded in.
1. @sentry/nextjs (named dependency). Node runtime only: instrumentation.ts `register()` loads sentry.server.config.ts when `process.env.NEXT_RUNTIME === "nodejs"` and a DSN is set; no edge config; instrumentation-client.ts inits only when NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN is set. `onRequestError` is the single capture owner for thrown errors; withApi captures only handled 5xx responses from handle() (explicit captureException with the route tag); test that one failure yields exactly one event.
2. next.config.ts: `withSentryConfig` applied only when SENTRY_DSN is set; `telemetry: false`, no tunnelRoute; source-map upload only when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN, SENTRY_ORG and SENTRY_PROJECT are all set. Test: next.config exports the unwrapped config when the DSN is unset.
3. beforeSend (src/lib/observability/beforeSend.ts): strips request.cookies, request.data, headers authorization/cookie/set-cookie and the forwarded-user header (FORWARDED_USER_HEADER), request.url query string, user, breadcrumb data, extra and contexts; runs the sync redact over message, exception values and breadcrumb messages; returns null when redaction throws. sendDefaultPii false. Tests per field.
4. src/lib/log: one JSON line per call {ts, level, event, ...fields, requestId?}; string field values pass through redact; safe for circular and Error values; reserved keys (ts, level, event) cannot be overridden; x-request-id accepted only when it matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$/ else random. Workspace id logged as a truncated salted sha256 (salt from FORWARDED_USER_SECRET or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, fixed test fixture). Routes outside withApi (cron/retention, redact, vision, auth/onboarding, health) get a request log line through a shared `withRequestLog` helper; withApi logs the requireContext early-return branch too. Convert console.warn/error under src/app/api/** to log.*; guard test greps.
5. src/app/api/health/route.ts: exports `runtime = "nodejs"`, GET answers 200 {ok, sentry, mode} with Cache-Control: no-store, no auth (the proxy skips /api); update runtime.test.ts, routes.auth.test.ts and routes.scope.test.ts allowlists so the public route passes.
6. docs/OBSERVABILITY.md: env names, what the human sets up (EU org), how to force a test error on web and API without a production backdoor, rollback (DSN unset kill switch, redeploy for NEXT_PUBLIC_ changes, revert of package.json/lock), and the Sentry ingest host note for a future CSP (vercel.json has none today; confirm).
README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example untouched. No other new dependencies.
acceptance: DSN unset: no server, client or next.config Sentry wiring (tests mock @sentry/nextjs and assert no init; next.config exports the unwrapped config); nodejs only, no edge config file
One failure yields exactly one Sentry event: thrown errors via onRequestError, handled 5xx via withApi (test)

beforeSend strips cookies, body, authorization/cookie/set-cookie/forwarded-user headers, url query, user, breadcrumb data, extra, contexts and redacts message, exception values, breadcrumb messages; returns null if redaction throws (tests)

log.* JSON lines: redacted string fields, safe for circular/Error, reserved keys protected, sanitised request id, hashed workspace id; every route under src/app/api/** logs one request line (withApi or withRequestLog); no console.warn/error remain (guard test)
GET /api/health: runtime nodejs, 200, no-store, no auth; runtime/auth/scope suites updated and green
docs/OBSERVABILITY.md written; README.md, docs/DEPLOY.md, .env.example untouched; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh wt/THIS-TASK exits 0
